offerTitle: Your drawing. A matching supply proposal.
offerBody: Send a drawing, dimensions or a photo of your current part. We review manufacturability with production partners and confirm the specification needed for a matching quotation.

nextReview: We review your application and clarify missing dimensions or material details.

requestType: What would you like to do?
successNext: Your request has been saved. We will review the details and contact you at the email provided. If you email a drawing or photo, include this reference so we can match it to your request.
sourceNotice: With your enquiry, we save the entry page, referring website domain and campaign labels, when available, to understand the source of the request. These are kept in this browser tab for up to 24 hours; full referral addresses and unrelated link parameters are not saved.
familyNote: This page describes a product family, not a single stocked configuration. Send your drawing, dimensions or a sample so we can review a suitable supply route.
supplierReviewBody: Review our company information, supply approach and sampling process, or contact us for the documents relevant to your assessment.
paymentCheckBody: The contracting entity, payment details and delivery arrangements for your order are stated in the quotation and commercial documents. If any company or bank details are unclear or change, confirm them with us through a contact channel you already know before paying.
ndaNote: Need a confidentiality agreement before sharing drawings? Contact us first at contact@keliran.com so we can agree an appropriate document-sharing process.
chatContinueBody: You do not need to submit this enquiry again. Reply in the same chat with any remaining dimensions or application details.
whatsappProductMessage: Hello Keliran, I would like to discuss {product} (ref. {ref}).
candidateNote: These families are starting points for discussion. Confirm the drawing, actual grade and assembly before selection.
prepareBody: Record what you know and mark missing information for advice. Supply dimensions with units, measurement positions and the drawing revision; no default value is assumed.
materialRoleNote: Material names identify options for review, not an approved grade or confirmed availability. Specify the backing channel and mounting holder separately.
blankRecordBody: Use this printable record to organise a proposed investigation. It contains no customer result or approved inspection data. Keep the symptom, measurement position, drawing revision and evidence together.
aluminiumReview: Aluminium requires separate supply review. Mentioning it in a drawing or specification does not confirm availability.
autoReplyIntro: Thank you for your enquiry to {site}. It has been saved, and we will review the details and contact you at this email address.
autoReplyFollowUp: To add drawings, photos or other details, reply to this email and keep the enquiry reference in the subject line.
autoReplyAutomatic: This is an automatic confirmation. If you did not send this enquiry, you can ignore this message.
